payload.objective: Assess the feasibility of animal-to-human PMB exposure prediction and efficacious-dose estimation using preclinical PK/PD (SC001).

context_sources.main:/objective: Assess the feasibility of animal-to-human PMB exposure prediction and efficacious-dose estimation using preclinical PK/PD (SC001).
context_sources.main:/study/regimen: Partial, separate regimen information: mouse dose-fractionation schedules, rat IV administration, and horse single- and repeated-dose summaries (SC007, SC008, SC012).
context_sources.main:/study/population: Mouse, rat, rabbit, held-out healthy and hospitalized horses, K. pneumoniae, and a human validation cohort (SC007, SC008, SC010, SC012, SC014, SC016).
context_sources.main:/study/system: Animal-to-human systemic and pulmonary PK with preclinical antibacterial PK/PD (SC019, SC024, SC027, SC028).
context_sources.main:/study/measurements: Concentration-time, binding, susceptibility and antibacterial-response evidence (SC007, SC008, SC010, SC012, SC014, SC016).
context_sources.main:/study/methods: Data preparation, animal PK modeling, interspecies prediction, PK/PD regression, independent human validation and PTA (SC018, SC019, SC024, SC027, SC028, SC029).
context_sources.main:/scientific_context/items/0/stateme: Test whether animal PK and preclinical PK/PD can predict human PMB exposure and support efficacious-dose estimation. The primary outcome is model feasibility, not a clinical dosing recommendation or proof of generalizability.
context_sources.main:/scientific_context/items/1/stateme: PMB is a known-drug test case with existing human PK intended for independent validation.
context_sources.main:/scientific_context/items/2/stateme: PMB is the sole test drug; colistin and other antibiotics cannot substitute for it.
context_sources.main:/scientific_context/items/3/stateme: The planned translational approach follows the objective of Sou et al. (2021), Model-Informed Drug Development for Antimicrobials: Translational PK and PK/PD Modeling to Predict an Efficacious Human Dose for Apramycin, Clinical Pharmacology & Therapeutics 109:1063-1073, doi:10.1002/cpt.2104.
context_sources.main:/scientific_context/items/4/stateme: Do not import the apramycin model or its parameters into this project.
context_sources.main:/scientific_context/items/5/stateme: The proposal identifies PMB_source_tables_by_species.xlsx as the single animal and in-vitro workbook; its sheets retain source-shaped tables and notes rather than a ready-made modeling dataset.
context_sources.main:/scientific_context/items/6/stateme: The mouse workbook resources comprise plasma and ELF PK, serum-binding inputs (SC020), strain MICs, dose-fractionation schedules, bacterial-burden endpoints and digitized index-response panels. Panel matching is addressed in MI001.
context_sources.main:/scientific_context/items/7/stateme: The rat workbook resources comprise individual IV plasma profiles, serum and seven-tissue biodistribution means, and serum binding measured by dialysis and ultrafiltration.
context_sources.main:/scientific_context/items/8/stateme: The proposal cautions that the limited rat observations do not establish predictive validity.
context_sources.main:/scientific_context/items/9/stateme: The rabbit workbook resources comprise mean plasma, ELF and whole-lung profiles, exposure summaries, pulmonary infection outcomes and study metadata. Related unresolved issues are MI002, MI003 and MI004.
context_sources.main:/scientific_context/items/10/statem: Assess whether rabbit evidence identifies a model component or supports only exploratory constraints. Use it only to the extent it identifies a component, document exclusion or exploratory use, and preserve source discrepancies.
context_sources.main:/scientific_context/items/11/statem: The held-out horse resources comprise digitized serum concentrations from two veterinary studies—healthy-horse peaks and troughs and hospitalized-horse daily samples—and printed single- and repeated-dose summaries from a third study. Dose-basis and binding limitations are MI005 and MI006.
context_sources.main:/scientific_context/items/12/statem: Horse data cannot be used for fitting, model selection or scaling. Their permitted translation-check procedure is SC025.
context_sources.main:/scientific_context/items/13/statem: The In_vitro_MIC resources comprise K. pneumoniae time-kill data for BAA1705, KP619 and three KPC-2 isolates at two static concentrations; genotype and MIC data for six carbapenem-resistant isolates; and a surveillance MIC distribution.
context_sources.main:/scientific_context/items/14/statem: Use eligible time-kill data for PD and the surveillance MIC distribution for population-weighted attainment; that distribution cannot replace matched strain MICs.
context_sources.main:/scientific_context/items/15/statem: The described human validation resources are a 40-patient dataset containing 230 concentration records and 268 dose events, together with human reference tables. Availability and release conditions are recorded in MI007.
context_sources.main:/scientific_context/items/16/statem: The proposal assigns these resource roles: PMB_project_proposal.docx defines the task; AGENT_README.md explains package use and known gaps; benchmark_reference.json contains final-stage reference material, including published model-derived parameters and targets. Scientific-result access restrictions are in SC034.
context_sources.main:/scientific_context/items/17/statem: Planned preparation splits mixed source blocks into PK, PD, MIC, validation and benchmark inputs; checks provenance, units, dose histories, experimental units and missing fields; and identifies usable records and unresolved gaps before fitting.
context_sources.main:/scientific_context/items/18/statem: Planned animal PK work selects eligible systemic and, where supported, pulmonary models for mouse, rat and rabbit, evaluating fit, parameter identifiability and held-out prediction where the design permits. Rabbit use is governed by SC011.
context_sources.main:/scientific_context/items/19/statem: Two mouse serum-binding sources conflict: about 91% versus 97–99% bound. Resolution is tracked in MI008.
context_sources.main:/scientific_context/items/20/statem: Rat serum-binding sources conflict: 80% versus 92–99% bound. Resolution is tracked in MI009.
context_sources.main:/scientific_context/items/21/statem: Separate routes, formulations, analytes, total versus unbound drug, and plasma, serum, whole-lung tissue, BAL and ELF. Record a justification for every conversion or physiological bridge, and do not force unsupported pulmonary or multi-species models.
context_sources.main:/scientific_context/items/22/statem: Never average the conflicting binding sources in SC020 and SC021; carry fu as a sensitivity parameter.
context_sources.main:/scientific_context/items/23/statem: Planned translation uses supported animal models, body size, protein binding and justified physiological relationships; rat evidence is intended for pulmonary translation only where supported. Compare scaling with and without each species rather than assuming more species is better.
context_sources.main:/scientific_context/items/24/statem: After mouse, rat and rabbit scaling is frozen, predict horse profiles under the reported horse doses and compare them with the held-out horse figures as an intermediate test of prediction in a large-body-weight species. Record the result without retuning.
context_sources.main:/scientific_context/items/25/statem: Planned human prediction produces concentration-time profiles, AUC and Cmax with uncertainty under specified doses and routes, then freezes these predictions before opening human outcomes. Prediction scenarios are addressed in MI010.
context_sources.main:/scientific_context/items/26/statem: For eligible K. pneumoniae data, including eligible mouse PD evidence, compare fAUC/MIC, fCmax/MIC and fT>MIC using ordinary Emax and sigmoid Emax/Hill regression. Estimate supported exposure targets, or report that the available data cannot determine a best index or target. Pending determinations are MI012 and MI013.
context_sources.main:/scientific_context/items/27/statem: Under the freezing prerequisite in SC036, planned human validation applies the model to actual human dose histories and compares predicted and observed plasma PK, assessing ELF separately when compatible data exist. Report bias, precision, exposure agreement and predictive uncertainty against the prespecified criteria. Related unresolved items are MI007, MI014 and MI015.
context_sources.main:/scientific_context/items/28/statem: After PK validation and PD qualification, simulate a prespecified human population and dosing scenarios to estimate PTA at each MIC, and include an exploratory efficacious-dose estimate where supported. Scenario choices are MI016 and MI017; uncertainty handling is SC038.
context_sources.main:/scientific_context/items/29/statem: Deliver PTA tables and curves, the feasibility conclusion, uncertainty, the final published-result benchmark and reproducible code. If required inputs are missing, report why PTA is not estimable.
context_sources.main:/scientific_context/items/30/statem: Keep source identifiers, units, missing values and BLQ limits. Do not treat group means or digitized observations as individual animals, or invent IDs, variability, exposure-response links or missing measurements; specifically, group summaries cannot supply invented interindividual variability.
context_sources.main:/scientific_context/items/31/statem: Give all three indices in SC027 equal eligibility. Compare the indices and both regression families on the same matched response records, strain MICs, free-exposure basis, dosing histories, time windows and likelihood. Register the selection rule before regression fitting; report R², AIC/BIC, stability and identifiability, counting the extra Hill parameter. Do not select by R² alone or force a winner. The selection rule is tracked in MI011.
context_sources.main:/scientific_context/items/32/statem: Keep stasis, 1-log kill and 2-log kill targets separate; other pathogens cannot set K. pneumoniae targets.
context_sources.main:/scientific_context/items/33/statem: Keep scientific results in benchmark_reference.json hidden during selection. Published fitted parameters and model-derived results cannot set primary-analysis starting values, bounds, priors or rankings; reserve them for the final benchmark.
context_sources.main:/scientific_context/items/34/statem: Human outcomes cannot tune the animal model or scaling.
context_sources.main:/scientific_context/items/35/statem: Freeze the model and validation criteria before their validation step, and freeze PD targets before dose simulation. MIC-input freezing is specified in SC037.
context_sources.main:/scientific_context/items/36/statem: For MIC/PTA processing, preserve MIC bins, units, counts/proportions, denominators and censored categories; derive probabilities transparently and freeze the MIC distribution/input before dose simulation. Never silently renormalize incomplete coverage. Report per-MIC PTA separately from MIC-weighted attainment. Coverage assessment is MI018.
context_sources.main:/scientific_context/items/37/statem: Include supported PK variability in PTA and propagate parameter, binding, PD-target and MIC uncertainty, subject to SC031. Variability support is addressed in MI019.
context_sources.main:/scientific_context/items/38/statem: Do not interpret a successful fit as predictive validation, or human PK agreement as validation of antibacterial efficacy or safety.
context_sources.main:/scientific_context/items/39/statem: Save transformations, assumptions, code, seeds and results.
context_sources.main:/scientific_context/items/41/statem: The selected proposal is Animal to Human Translation of Polymyxin B, feasibility study Version 3.0 (draft), dated 8 October 2026; it states that it supersedes earlier versions.
context_sources.main:/scientific_context/items/42/statem: Prior approvals do not automatically carry forward to this proposal.
context_sources.main:/scientific_context/items/43/statem: Preserve the original validation result if a later model is revised.
context_sources.main:/scientific_context/items/44/statem: Preserve failures and data gaps in the documented conclusions.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/0/impact: Mouse panels cannot be treated as matched regimen-level exposure-response records without verification.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/0/why_it: The proposal explicitly states that separate mouse panels are not verified matched regimen records; attachment bodies have not been searched.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/0/clarif: Verify the panel, regimen, strain-MIC and response associations required by SC032, documenting supported matches and unresolved links.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/1/field: Additional public rabbit PMB concentration evidence
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/1/impact: The reported availability limit must inform the eligibility assessment of rabbit evidence.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/1/why_it: The proposal reports that no further public rabbit PMB concentration data were found. This does not establish absence from all sources or unread attachment contents.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/1/clarif: Record the scope and consequences of this source-reported availability limit during adequacy assessment.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/2/impact: The decision to include a rabbit model component or retain exploratory constraints remains pending.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/2/why_it: The assessment required by SC011 has not been supplied; workbook contents have not been inspected.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/2/clarif: Assess component identifiability and record the inclusion, exclusion or exploratory-use decision under SC011.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/3/impact: Rabbit source values cannot be reconciled or selected without identifying the discrepancies.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/3/why_it: The proposal flags rabbit source discrepancies but does not specify their affected values or contexts; attachment bodies remain unsearched.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/3/clarif: Identify and preserve the rabbit discrepancies with their source, study, matrix and measurement context, without silently resolving them.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/4/impact: The dose basis limits interpretation of held-out horse predictions and any mass-dose comparison.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/4/why_it: Horse doses are mostly reported in IU without salt or base correction; a supported mass-equivalent basis is unresolved.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/4/clarif: Clarify each horse study's reported dose basis and any supported salt/base correction, retaining reported units and documenting unresolved limitations for SC025.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/5/impact: Binding-dependent interpretation of the held-out horse translation requires an explicit limitation or justified handling.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/5/why_it: The proposal explicitly states that no horse binding is available.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/5/clarif: Document how SC025 will be interpreted without horse-binding evidence; do not invent a binding value.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/6/impact: Human validation cannot use the protected resources before their authorized release.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/6/why_it: Human validation data are not in the supplied package. The dataset and reference tables described in SC016 are held in a separate file and released only at task 5, after the animal model, scaling and predictions are frozen.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/6/clarif: Release the separate human validation file only at the stated task and after all stated freezing conditions are met.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/7/impact: Mouse free-exposure calculations and binding-dependent translation require sensitivity handling of the conflicting sources.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/7/why_it: The conflicting mouse binding values are preserved in SC020; their contextual reconciliation and sensitivity treatment remain unresolved.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/7/clarif: Identify the source definitions and experimental contexts and define justified mouse fu sensitivity handling under SC023.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/8/impact: Rat free-exposure calculations and binding-dependent translation require sensitivity handling of the conflicting sources.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/8/why_it: The conflicting rat binding values are preserved in SC021; their contextual reconciliation and sensitivity treatment remain unresolved.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/8/clarif: Identify the source definitions and experimental contexts and define justified rat fu sensitivity handling under SC023.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/9/field: Human PK prediction doses and routes
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/9/impact: The human concentration-time, AUC and Cmax prediction scenarios cannot be fully defined.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/9/why_it: The supplied proposal requires specified human prediction doses and routes in SC026 but does not supply those choices; this is not a finding about unread files.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/9/clarif: Specify the human PK prediction dosing scenarios, including their doses and routes, before generating and freezing predictions.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/10/impac: Index ranking cannot proceed without the preregistered comparison rule.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/10/why_i: SC032 requires registration before regression fitting, but the proposal does not supply the rule.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/10/clari: Register the selection rule before fitting, retaining SC032's comparison conditions and prohibition on forcing a winner.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/11/why_i: SC027 explicitly allows the outcome that available eligible data cannot determine a best index; no completed comparison is supplied.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/11/clari: Assess index discrimination using eligible matched data and report indeterminacy if the evidence does not support selection.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/12/impac: PD qualification and subsequent target-attainment simulation depend on whether supported targets can be estimated.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/12/why_i: Target estimation in SC027 is conditional on support and has not been performed in the supplied proposal.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/12/clari: Assess which exposure targets are estimable under SC033 and report when no supported target can be determined.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/13/impac: Human predictive performance cannot receive a prespecified acceptance judgment.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/13/why_i: The criteria required by SC028 and SC036 are not specified in the proposal.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/13/clari: Fix the criteria for bias, precision, exposure agreement and predictive uncertainty before validation.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/14/impac: The conditional ELF branch of human validation cannot yet be determined.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/14/why_i: SC028 requires separate ELF assessment when compatible data exist; compatibility and availability have not been assessed in the supplied proposal.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/14/clari: At authorized validation access, determine whether compatible human ELF evidence exists and document the separate assessment or its limitation.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/15/impac: PTA population simulation cannot be defined.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/15/why_i: SC029 requires a prespecified human population, but the proposal supplies no population specification for PTA.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/15/clari: Prespecify the human PTA population before simulation.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/16/impac: PTA regimen comparisons and exploratory efficacious-dose estimation cannot be defined.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/16/why_i: SC029 requires prespecified dosing scenarios for the later PTA phase, distinct from the human PK prediction inputs in MI010.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/16/clari: Prespecify the PTA dosing scenarios before simulation, after the stated PK-validation and PD-qualification prerequisites.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/17/impac: The distribution's suitability for population-weighted attainment remains unassessed.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/17/why_i: SC037 requires explicit treatment of coverage; the proposal supplies no completed coverage assessment, and the workbook has not been searched.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/17/clari: Assess and document surveillance MIC coverage before accepting the distribution for weighted attainment, retaining any incomplete coverage explicitly.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/18/impac: The variability basis for PTA simulation remains unqualified.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/18/why_i: The proposal requires supported PK variability but supplies no completed assessment of whether defensible individual variability can be supported.
context_sources.main:/missing_information/items/18/clari: Assess which PK variability is defensible for PTA and specify its use under SC031 and SC038 before simulation.

Preserve the scope, conditions, prohibitions, exceptions and downstream consequences of project requirements; flag questionable scientific requirements instead of silently rewriting them.
Report ambiguous scope and conflicting requirements. Changes to the project question or permissions need an authorized revised specification.
rules.on_failure: Identify the unsupported scope change or affected requirement and seek a source-supported correction or targeted clarification before dependent decisions.

ordering: Information and tasks needed to answer or critically assess that objective
Supporting context and explicitly optional work
priority_policy.failure_policy: A missing, altered, unsupported or materially ambiguous objective cannot be offset by success on other checklist items. Use the task-specific clarification or failure path.
priority_policy.implementation: Model instructions and task-contract priority; not model attention weights, a numeric scoring algorithm, or proof of a deterministic semantic gate.

rules.title: Scientific meaning, uncertainty and provenance
rules.instruction: Preserve decision-relevant scientific meaning and trace each retained claim or derived result to appropriate evidence.
actions: Retain quantities, units, identities, definitions, experimental units, relationships, conditions, negation and exceptions using the applicable module-specific scientific checklist.
Distinguish explicit absence, not found, unsearched or inaccessible evidence, ambiguity and conflict. Missing evidence is not proof of absent data; do not invent values or resolve conflicts silently.

Authorized cleaning, conversions, fitting and simulation may change representations or derive results. Record inputs, units, methods, code and configuration as applicable; distinguish observed, reconstructed, calculated and predicted values.

Preserve source and location references for extracted statements. Computed results require computational provenance, not fabricated source quotations; record consequential unresolved items and their impacts.
Check that evidence supports a claim in its context, including relevant qualifications and counterevidence. A matching quotation, identifier or valid schema alone does not establish semantic support.
Apply the shared evidence_handling contract: distinguish access permission, retrieval coverage and claim support; do not equate keyword hit lists with scientific relevance.
rules.on_failure: Expose the missing evidence, altered meaning or untraceable transformation and stop affected decisions until the applicable module gate is satisfied.

rules.title: Minimal sufficient task context
rules.instruction: For every workflow stage and agent handoff, provide the minimum self-contained semantic context needed to perform the assigned task and satisfy its output contract. Complete host retention does not require complete model exposure.
actions: Define the task decision, output contract and stage boundary first. Each input section must serve that task; do not forward entire upstream objects or the complete knowledge library by default.

Keep applicable rule wording, scope, conditions, exceptions, prohibitions, uncertainty and consequential evidence in the model context. Do not shorten by hard truncation, dropping required rules, omitting counterevidence or hiding unresolved restrictions. Complete-source extraction and independent review still receive every permitted source unit needed by their contract.

Keep hashes, version-binding machinery, local audit paths, full provenance ledgers and duplicated transport metadata on the host unless the current task or response contract needs that specific value. Keep source names, locators and the identifiers required for attribution, scientific identity, relationships or valid output references; an identifier without its relevant meaning is insufficient.

Represent repeated task information once with clear shared definitions and explicit scope links. Never merge independent experimental units or claims merely because wording matches. Avoid opaque encodings or a reference maze that transfers reconstruction work to the agent.

Planning receives only task-relevant design distinctions, not the complete per-table inventory or source-note history. Complete source details remain available to extraction, coverage, cleaning and independent review. Keep unique task constraints; summaries cannot imply joins, completeness, source permission or scientific adequacy.

Retrieve optional background only for a concrete question not answered by supplied task inputs. Record the existing basis or the unanswered need before retrieval; zero background is valid. Stay within authorized sources and methods, deduplicate evidence with source scope, and never substitute retrieval for mandatory evidence or project authority.

The host records included and host-only fields with their purpose, exact input/configuration bindings and preservation checks. Compare the actual model-visible prompt, not only host object size. Schema validity and fewer characters do not establish sufficient context or response quality.
rules.on_failure: Reassemble the missing task information or remove irrelevant repetition, then recheck rule and evidence preservation, output-reference closure and task sufficiency. If necessary context does not fit, stop or redesign the authorized task boundary; never silently truncate.

rules.title: Version-bound inputs, outputs and reviews
rules.instruction: Bind results and approvals to the exact input artifacts, candidate, instructions, rules and execution configuration they assessed.
actions: Preserve immutable snapshots and provenance sufficient to identify the reviewed work; keep old results bound to their original versions.
Reuse work only when the relevant bindings, artifact integrity and current validation checks permit it. Changed inputs or configurations never inherit stale approval.
The host creates and validates artifact identities; agents must not invent bindings or treat a matching identifier alone as scientific validation.

An authorized revision must identify the prior requirement or specification, affected scope and effective conditions. A newer date alone does not establish replacement; retain predecessor and decision evidence.
rules.on_failure: Reject mismatched or stale results, identify the changed dependency and follow the task-specific revision policy.

rules.title: Actionable failures and scoped acceptance
rules.instruction: Apply the assigned validation and release criteria; a PASS establishes only what the task actually assessed.
actions: For each failure identify the step or field, evidence, cause, impact, correction or missing input, and the next permitted action.
Distinguish execution failure, invalid output, semantic or scientific defects, missing evidence and unassessed questions; do not claim a scientific gap from a transport error.
Preserve failed artifacts and unresolved findings. A required failure cannot be waived by another PASS or erased by repeatedly sampling unchanged material for a favorable answer.
Release affected outputs only after required checks and human gates pass. Follow the module retry policy; deterministic contract checks do not establish scientific or live-model semantic validity.
Classify evidence failures using evidence_handling and follow its bounded, audited correction path only when this step has an implemented adapter. Uncertain permissions or meaning remain blocked.
rules.on_failure: Withhold the affected successful handoff and provide actionable findings; retain unrelated completed work according to the authorized workflow policy.

rules.title: Unresolved items reach and are closed by the step that needs them
rules.instruction: Carry each consequential unresolved item as one structured record from the step that identifies it to the step that needs it. That step must explicitly record how the item is closed or carried; no step may drop it or close it silently.
actions: An unresolved item is information or a check that a later decision depends on and that is not yet settled: NOT_FOUND, SEARCH_INCOMPLETE, DEFERRED (protected or intentionally later-stage evidence), AMBIGUOUS, CONFLICT, or an OPEN_FINDING from a review. Keep these statuses distinct as G004 requires.

Record each item once with: id, the affected field or decision, status, needed_at (the first workflow step whose decision depends on it), impact, origin (producing step and artifact; implicit when the record is in that step's own handoff) and resolution_status OPEN. Use the step's own schema fields; where the schema has no record field, cite the item ID in its findings or uncertainty fields and do not add fields outside the schema.

Each handoff before needed_at forwards every open item unchanged in ID, status, meaning and origin, including items the receiving step does not use. Do not merge, renumber or duplicate an item across steps, or reword it into a vaguer note or a different status (G001).

Before its dependent decision, the needed_at step checks every item addressed to it and records one outcome with its reason: RESOLVED, citing the evidence or the recorded human decision; LIMITATION_ACCEPTED, only where that step's gate or a recorded human decision permits proceeding, with the limitation stated in the affected output; ESCALATED to the responsible owner or human review, keeping the dependent decision pending; or CARRIED to a later needed_at, stating why the decision belongs there.
A PASS, a successful later step, elapsed time or the absence of new evidence does not close an item. NOT_FOUND alone never proves absence (G004).

Bind each closure to the evidence, decision and artifact versions it relied on (G006). Keep closed and carried items with their predecessor records in audit, and reopen an item when the evidence or decision it relied on changes. Items still affecting a released output are stated as limitations of that output.
rules.implementation: Host-enforced from context compression through the Data handoff: CC019 publishes main.json.missing_information; the Data agents keep each open item in unresolved_ledger.json; DC-review (DC007) and DH-handoff (DH004) must record one checked outcome for every item due before QC or EDA, and an escalated item keeps that gate closed; every eda, pk and index handoff forwards the still-open items unchanged with the accepted limitations. Downstream modules do not yet record outcomes; until their contracts adopt the ledger, this rule is a model instruction there.
rules.on_failure: Withhold the dependent decision or handoff and report the dropped, altered or silently closed item with its ID, the step where it was lost and its needed_at step.

governance.instruction_prefix: Apply governance rule G001 first, then all supplied shared principles G002 through G008 within this task, followed by the step-specific rules. Use G003 as the primary task-relevance anchor; this never overrides the other mandatory rules. Read their full inline text; IDs alone are insufficient. Governance is processing policy, not source evidence or a project R rule.

application.delivery: Inline in new agent requests and snapshotted in new workflow task contracts; each principle is applied within the assigned scope.
application.boundaries: Module-specific permissions, scientific details and acceptance tests remain in their own contracts. This pack does not enable selective project reruns or new scientific computations.
application.legacy: Historical requests keep their frozen governance and instruction prefix; no retroactive migration of approvals.
application.enforcement: Shared instructions plus existing host checks; activation is not proof that every semantic requirement has a deterministic validator.

evidence_handling.principle: Separate source access, retrieval coverage and claim support in every workflow step.

checks.access: Enforce task-authorized files, stage restrictions, protected/holdout boundaries and source integrity before reading or using evidence.
checks.retrieval: Treat keyword matches as candidate retrieval, not scientific proof or the final permission boundary. No hit means incomplete retrieval unless adequate search is established.
checks.support: Verify the source supports this question and this specific claim, preserving relevant identity, experimental context, units, time, conditions, uncertainty and counterevidence.

failure_classes.ACCESS_DENIED: Stop; another agent or a relevant-looking quotation cannot expand permissions.
failure_classes.SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: Locate readable authorized evidence or report what is missing; do not invent a source.
failure_classes.RETRIEVAL_INCOMPLETE: Request scoped additional retrieval where authorized; otherwise retain SEARCH_INCOMPLETE.
failure_classes.QUESTION_SCOPE_MISMATCH: An already supplied source from an authorized file may be reassigned only after scoped relevance review and a recorded source-to-question decision.
failure_classes.QUOTE_MISMATCH: Correct only from the actual authorized source, preserving the linked claim; revalidate exact wording and meaning.
failure_classes.UNSUPPORTED_CLAIM: Do not fix by swapping in a convenient quote. Revise the claim from evidence or retain an unresolved finding.
failure_classes.SOURCE_CONFLICT: Preserve conflicting evidence and stop dependent acceptance pending the applicable review.

correction.activation: Automatic correction requires an implemented and declared adapter for the current step; this general policy alone does not enable one.
correction.scope: Send a fresh reviewer only the affected task, objective, claim, relevant sources and applicable constraints. Do not rerun unrelated upstream work to repair a citation.
correction.budget: The step must declare a finite correction budget. No unbounded retry or repeated unchanged sampling for PASS.
correction.validation: Revalidate the corrected fields and all affected relationships; preserve the original response, correction, evidence mapping and exact input/version bindings. Mandatory semantic and human gates remain in force.
correction.failure: When the budget is exhausted or meaning/permission remains uncertain, stop the affected handoff with a specific reason and next action.

evidence_handling.pass_limit: A real quotation is not proof of claim support; an accepted correction is not scientific adequacy or predictive validity.
